name: glabrezu
lore:
Glabrezu, the tempters of the Abyss, are masters of manipulation, preying on the desires of mortals for power. Unlike succubi, who exploit lust, glabrezu weave intricate webs of deceit, offering influence and riches in exchange for souls. Their monstrous appearance, with canine heads, goat horns, and mismatched pairs of arms, belies their cunning intellect and silver tongues. They lurk in the shadows, whispering promises and twisting desires, leading mortals down paths of corruption and ruin. 

These demons amass vast hoards of gold and magical items, using them as bait to ensnare their victims. They prefer to work in secret, using telepathy to plant seeds of paranoia and discord in the minds of their prey. Glabrezu revel in the downfall of those who succumb to their temptations, their schemes often spanning centuries as they patiently await the moment to claim their due. Beware the glabrezu, for their gifts come at a terrible price, and their whispers can lead even the most virtuous souls to eternal damnation. In the layers of the Abyss, they are the architects of ruin, and their influence stretches far beyond the borders of their infernal realm.
